summary: During active fighting in Gaza in October 2025, Pillen traveled to Israel on what his office called a 'trade and solidarity mission,' met October 7th victims, and was scheduled to meet Netanyahu. In June 2026 he stated that Palestinians 'want to kill every Jewish person,' a collective dehumanization. His May 2026 executive order separately mandates IHRA adoption in Nebraska public schools and higher education, anchoring state curricula to a framework that restricts legitimate criticism of Israel.
